thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: The 10/28 third-quarter print shows refining capture well below guidance or management guides fourth-quarter margins down; or the 10/22 VLO call flags a sharp margin normalization.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $280 (the stop), or a close under $285 while CVX and XOM hold their levels, which would be stock-specific failure rather than a sector washout.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If PSX has not closed above $297.40 (the 52-week high) by 2026-10-30, two sessions after the print, exit; the breakout thesis will have failed to resolve.
